changes.old: I: 2 money per water/rock icon. You may cover water/rock spaces and ignore terrain requirements of animals and unique buildings; their printed terrain icons still count. Terrain need not be covered for a full map. Covered terrain stops counting for Hydrologist, Geologist and Architectural Zoo. F: 2 appeal per water-icon/rock-icon pair, maximum three pairs.
changes.new: I: **2 money per water/rock icon**. R: You may cover water/rock spaces and ignore terrain requirements of animals and unique buildings; their printed terrain icons still count. Terrain need not be covered for a full map. Covered terrain stops counting for Hydrologist, Geologist and Architectural Zoo. F: 2 appeal per water-icon/rock-icon pair, maximum three pairs.

changes.old: Place the building and three supply tokens on its card. Per herbivore icon played, you may spend one token to play a **hand Sponsor** for money equal to its level, observing its normal conditions. Its own icon can trigger this when the Stable is played. Three uses total.
changes.new: Place the building and three supply tokens on its card. Per herbivore icon played, you may spend one token and **pay money equal to a hand Sponsor’s level** to play that Sponsor, observing its normal conditions. Its own icon can trigger this when the Stable is played. Three uses total.
